digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler package structure / jira adapter
propositions: Eight Jira-specific modules (acli.py, acli_cli_ops.py, acli_graph.py, acli_rest.py, acli_subprocess.py, adf.py, outbound_fields.py, comment_limits.py) must be relocated from package root to adapters/jira/ directory per ADR 0035
Location-pinned modules (adf.py, outbound_fields.py, comment_limits.py) require simultaneous loader updates to relative subpaths to avoid breaking dynamic file-location loading
All surviving references across ~29 dotted imports, sibling-path loads, and test patches must be atomically repointed to new paths with no re-export shims
Loader modification at _loader.py lines 39 and 56 must support relative subpath resolution for three modules while leaving ~30 other root module loads unaffected
